title: EnvBoardModels
description: Runtime state for the env:board API-credit balance lane: live settings written by the Herdr controls mod and the on-disk balance cache. Neither file is a mise-managed dotfile.

EnvBoardSettings.description: Live board settings (${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/env-board/settings.json), re-read every tick.

balance_interval_min.description: Minutes between automatic api:balance reads (clamped to 5..240).

balance_paused.description: When true no automatic api:balance call is made.

refresh_requested_at.description: ISO instant of the latest Refresh-now click; newer than the last attempt triggers a read (rate-limited to once per 60 s).

EnvBoardPromoTranche.description: One promotional credit tranche from api:balance --json.

EnvBoardBalanceCache.description: On-disk balance cache (${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/env-board/balance-cache.json, mode 0600): last good read, last attempt, last error.

last_served_request.description: Latest refresh_requested_at already acted on; a request is served at most once.
